papers.title: From Seeing to Remembering: Brain-Informed Agentic Text-to-Video Generation for Enhancing Memorability
papers.excerpt: In this paper, we propose MemCrafter, brain-informed approach that enhances video memorability through iteratively agentic prompt refinement.
papers.note: MemCrafter 根据预测的脑区响应估计生成视频的可记忆性，再用这个信号迭代修改 Prompt。作者评估的是预测可记忆性，以及修改后视频与原始语义的吻合程度。

papers.title: MAST: Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering for Visual Grounding in Multimodal LLMs
papers.excerpt: To address this, we propose MAST (Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering), a training-free, input-adaptive activation steering framework.
papers.note: MAST 针对 Multimodal LLM 的 Visual Grounding，在推理时根据当前输入调整中间激活，不需要重新训练模型。

papers.title: CineMME: From Dialogue Grounding to Narrative Reasoning in Multimodal Video Understanding
papers.excerpt: We introduce CineMME, a human-verified benchmark designed to diagnose dialogue-grounded plot understanding, supported by approximately $1,600$ expert person-hours of annotation.
papers.note: CineMME 用同一批短视频检验两件事：模型能否定位哪位角色在何时说了什么，以及能否用这段对白解释剧情。作者观察到，正确转录台词的模型仍可能认错说话者。

papers.title: Teach with Blinks: Breaking Linguistic Momentum in On-Policy Distillation for Fine-Grained Multimodal Perception
papers.excerpt: To address this, we propose Blink On-Policy Distillation (BlinkOPD), in which the teacher "blinks" at every token: it reads the same prefix once with…
papers.note: BlinkOPD 让 teacher 在每个 token 位置读取同一段前文两次，一次看图、一次遮住视觉输入。两次预测的差异为细粒度感知提供训练信号。

papers.title: CaseScope: A Multi-Field Benchmark for Case-Level Pathology Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs
papers.excerpt: We introduce CaseScope, a benchmark of diagnosis from several curated fields of one lesion: CaseScope-Teaching, 436 cases from a residency-training image library, reconstructed, de-identified…
papers.note: CaseScope 把同一病变的多张视野图组成一例，测试 Multimodal LLM 能否跨图整合证据。作者通过打乱诊断选项和增减图像，检查答案对选项顺序及额外视觉证据的依赖。
